purpose: Keep manuscript wording mechanically aligned with the strongest evidence actually licensed.

allowed_phrasing: the estimand is recoverable under the synthetic test
the pathway is exercised in controlled worlds
the implementation reproduces the preregistered synthetic contrast
consistent with the preregistered case prediction
improves held-out performance in this case

minimum_evidence: same mechanism survives at least two eligible transfer cases
measurement and case-input sensitivity do not reverse the result
allowed_phrasing: robust across the preregistered transfer set

minimum_evidence: major negative and boundary cases retained
construct-specific predictive or explanatory advantage demonstrated
allowed_phrasing: general theory within the stated scope conditions
generalizable mechanism across the tested domain

causal_language_rule: Historical causal wording requires an identified intervention or mechanism contrast appropriate to the claim; synthetic mechanism recovery alone is insufficient.
prediction_language_rule: Prediction claims must identify the outcome, holdout, comparator, and observation definition. Predicting violence does not license wording about control.
policy_language_rule: Policy-effectiveness language requires the multidimensional outcome vector and cannot be licensed by a violence-only improvement.
